report.summary: The only failure is test_invalid_book_is_rejected[blank-title], which expected a whitespace-only title to get 422 but got 201. The app is deliberately seeded with a blank_title bug that skips the blank-title check when the BUGS env var contains it, and the test server inherits the CI environment, so the run most likely had BUGS=blank_title set. First, check the CI job's environment for BUGS: if the seeded bug was meant to be on, treat this as a real detected defect; if not, unset it and rerun.

causes.title: Whitespace-only titles are accepted because the seeded blank_title bug is active
causes.explanation: validate_book only rejects a blank title when "blank_title" is not in BUGS, so with that flag set a title of "   " passes validation and the API returns 201 Created. The test is correct to expect 422 under the intended behavior, so the failure reflects the application behaving wrongly under the enabled flag. The repo does not show where BUGS is set for this run; the most likely source is the CI environment, since conftest.py starts uvicorn with os.environ copied in. The other three parametrized cases passed, so the server itself is running and only this check is affected.
evidence: tests/api/test_books_api.py:66 assert response.status_code == 422 failed with 'assert 201 == 422' (test input book = {'title': '   ', 'author': 'A'})
app/main.py:86: if not book.title.strip() and "blank_title" not in BUGS:
app/main.py:31: BUGS = {b.strip() for b in os.environ.get("BUGS", "").split(",") if b.strip()}
app/main.py:10 docstring: "blank_title  accepts a title made only of spaces"
tests/conftest.py:57: env = {**os.environ, "DB_PATH": db_path} (server inherits BUGS from the CI environment)
list_failures: only this one test failed; tests=26, failures=1, errors=0
causes.suggested_fix: First confirm whether BUGS=blank_title is set in the CI job. If it was not meant to be set, remove it so the app validates titles normally. If the run intentionally enables seeded bugs, leave the test as a detection of the defect (or mark it xfail with a reason referencing blank_title) and track it as a known product bug. Do not change the test's expected 422.
